# Capabilities in delfin/agent/ that the PRODUCT does not reach.
#
# Written by tests/test_every_capability_has_a_caller.py, which refuses a
# name that is not in here. Columns: tier, name, where it is defined.
#
# tier "nowhere"   -- nothing in delfin/ or tests/ names it at all. Dead
#                     code, or a capability that was never connected.
# tier "test-only" -- only the suite reaches it. The capability exists and
#                     is proven, and nothing in the running product uses
#                     it.
#
# A name LEAVES this list by being connected or deleted, and the test then
# requires the list to be shortened: the count only goes down. Adding a
# line is a deliberate act and belongs in a pull request of its own, with
# the reason.
#
# Measured 2026-11-20, by the functions in that test file, so the list
# and the check cannot compute it differently.
nowhere	_project_settings_paths	delfin/agent/hooks.py:164
nowhere	controller_hint	delfin/agent/loop_commands.py:298
nowhere	request_swarm_pause	delfin/agent/swarm/lead.py:110
test-only	_bypass_failure_asks	delfin/agent/api_client.py:14120

# _default_keyring_factory (delfin/agent/credentials.py:400) -- no
# production path disables the keyring. Mounting one would be a new

# keyless, which does not exist.

# mounts --tmpfs /tmp. api_client.py is forbidden to this group (rule 13), so the

# check_ordering STAYS (measured 2026-11-22, wave 37 rr2): nothing in the
# product inspects a recorded head -- the engine turn (engine.py:3084)
# composes via compose_sections, joins (_held_system_prompt) and sends;
# the layer order is guaranteed at the source by construction
# (prompt_loader.py:2050 "the composition order IS the layer order"), so a
# product-composed head cannot violate it. The check is the suite/human
# measurement layer over recorded rows (as the adversarial test does:
# record the real engine rows, call the check from the test). Mounting it
# in the engine turn would be a tautological new surface (rule 12); the
# question that decides it is whether the product should surface an
# ordering violation to a person -- a design decision, not a repair.
test-only	check_ordering	delfin/agent/prompt_head.py:95
test-only	distill_for_shipping	delfin/agent/memory_distill.py:380

# (api_client._session_scratch_dir, delfin/agent/api_client.py:29532) never
# calls shared_tmp at all, and no cleanup path in delfin/ names this function.
# Deleting would orphan the quota pin tests (tests/test_shared_tmp_cleanup.py);
# mounting would need a product cleanup tick that does not exist (new surface,
# rule 12). Decides it: wiring the session-end cleanup to enforce_quota, or an
# operator decision that the product never quotas scratch.

test-only	for_files	delfin/agent/verify_recipe.py:327
# hostile_reach STAYS (measured 2026-11-22, wave 37 rr2): the only rows in
# a product-composed head that carry data (briefing, lessons, decomposition,
# chemistry, repo_map -- prompt_loader.py:2234-2264) are all LAYER_VOLATILE,
# which hostile_reach exempts (layer >= 2); the layer 0/1 rows are trusted
# addendum files and fixed route text. Product rows therefore cannot trip
# the check by construction -- it guards a future layer-assignment
# regression that would reclassify data into the cacheable head. Mounting
# it in the engine turn would be a per-turn tautology / new surface
# (rule 12); the deciding question is whether the product should enforce
# the invariant per turn -- a design decision, not a repair.

test-only	is_safe	delfin/agent/readonly_pipeline.py:371
